summary: Canvas improvements reduce stalls and speed up common workloads: offscreen-canvas workers get a fontGroup cache so frequent font changes won’t cause pathological slowdowns, CaptureStream() with WebGL now uses async readback for smoother streaming/snapshotting, and WebGL paths got robustness and performance fixes (shared PBOs, buffer-size limits aligned with WebGPU, and texel unpack specializations). Overall this makes canvas-based animations and captures more efficient and reliable, especially in worker/offscreen use.
